source: screener.in (company fundamentals, quarterly/yearly financials) + NSE archives (Nifty 50 / Nifty Midcap 150 / Nifty 200 / Nifty 500 constituents)
disclaimer: Educational/informational tool only. Not SEBI-registered investment advice. Strategy 'accuracy' is a historical, backward-looking cross-sectional measure over the tracked universe and does not guarantee future performance.
methodology_note: 500-stock universe (full Nifty 500, deduplicated) as of 2026-07-29. Blue Chip (40, Nifty 50 subset), Emerging (40, Nifty Midcap 150 subset) and Smart Pick universe (200, Nifty 200) retain their original category tags; all 500 stocks are additionally tagged 'nifty500' for full-universe search. Value/Growth/Technical strategy qualification and Smart Pick (>=2 of 3) are computed via medians across the full 500-stock universe. Quarterly (trailing ~8-13 quarters) and yearly (last 3-5 years) Revenue/Net Profit are included per stock for the search/detail view where available from screener.in.

value.label: Value
value.description: P/E at or below market median AND ROE at or above market median

growth.label: Growth
growth.description: 3-year profit growth AND 3-year sales growth both at or above market median

technical.label: Technical
technical.description: 1-year price CAGR at or above market median
